tasks.label: Backend: build
tasks.command: if (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { dotnet build } else { & "$env:USERPROFILE\dotnet\dotnet.exe" build }

tasks.label: Backend: run API (port 5000)
tasks.command: if (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { dotnet run --project src/AIInterviewPlatform.Api --launch-profile http } else { & "$env:USERPROFILE\dotnet\dotnet.exe" run --project src/AIInterviewPlatform.Api --launch-profile http }

tasks.label: Backend: run tests
tasks.command: if (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { dotnet test } else { & "$env:USERPROFILE\dotnet\dotnet.exe" test }
